provenance.title: Provenance
provenance.description: Where each System's values came from

planet.title: Planet
planet.description: Canonical archive pl_name; links chart, table and scene

excluded.title: Excluded
excluded.description: Why the planet is not plotted; None when it is plotted

Exclusion.title: Exclusion
Exclusion.description: Planets that pass every known condition but lack a value the search depends on.

field.title: Field
field.description: Allowlisted field name, e.g. radius or orbital_period

value.title: Value
value.description: Number to compare with (lower bound for between); text for =

Filter.title: Filter
Filter.description: One explicit condition on an allowlisted field.

as.title: As
as.description: How it was read, e.g. radius < 2 Earth radii

caveat.title: Caveat
caveat.description: Required for loaded words such as Earth-like or habitable

Interpretation.title: Interpretation
Interpretation.description: How a vague word in the student's request was read as a concrete filter.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Set when the value is a limit rather than a measurement

name.title: Name
name.description: Canonical archive pl_name; the planet's ID

mass_provenance.title: Mass Provenance
mass_provenance.description: Archive pl_bmassprov, e.g. Mass or Msini

current_system.title: Current System
current_system.description: Hostname shown in the System view

next_seq.title: Next Seq
next_seq.description: Next number for turn and item IDs

ProjectSummary.title: ProjectSummary
ProjectSummary.description: One row in the Project switcher. A file that can't be read is listed with its error.

Reference.title: Reference
Reference.description: The publication a catalog value comes from.

request.title: Request
request.description: What the student asked for, e.g. 'a report on ...'

includes.title: Includes
includes.description: IDs of the Project items the Report covers

file.title: File
file.description: The Report's HTML file name, rendered once and never edited

matched.title: Matched
matched.description: All planets matching the filters, before the limit

Sample.title: Sample
Sample.description: A set of planets selected by explicit, visible filters. Missing is never treated as zero.

name.title: Name
name.description: Canonical archive pl_name; the planet's ID

hostname.title: Hostname
hostname.description: Canonical archive hostname of its System

SetColorBy.title: SetColorBy
SetColorBy.description: Colour planets by one archive property, with a legend; "none" restores fixed colours.

SetTimeScale.title: SetTimeScale
SetTimeScale.description: Simulated days per real second; 0 pauses time.

StepRecord.title: StepRecord
StepRecord.description: One operation that ran during a turn, as shown in the chat and a Report's tool-call log.

hostname.title: Hostname
hostname.description: Canonical archive hostname; the System's ID

System.title: System
System.description: One host star and its known planets.

turn_id.title: Turn Id
turn_id.description: The turn that last opened this System

ToolStep.title: ToolStep
ToolStep.description: One operation that actually ran, timed with a monotonic clock.

web_search.description: The turn's web search, so its cited answer can be shown again

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: The Project this turn is saved to

project.description: The Project after this turn was saved; None if not saved

turn_id.title: Turn Id
turn_id.description: The turn that first cited it

WebSourceItem.title: WebSourceItem
WebSourceItem.description: A Web source cited in the Project, listed once even if several turns cite it.
